name: Band Triceps Pushdown
description: A resistance band version of the cable pushdown that can be performed anywhere. The band's accommodating resistance makes the exercise hardest at full extension where the triceps are strongest. This makes bands excellent for pumping and finishing sets.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Band Triceps Pushdown in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Band Triceps Pushdown.
steps: Step 1: Secure band overhead at a fixed point. Grasp band ends at chest level.
Step 2: Keep elbows pinned at sides throughout the movement.
Step 3: Push hands down by extending elbows to full lockout.
Step 4: Return slowly allowing band to pull hands back to start.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Control the band on the way up
